$comment: The only file you need to edit to retune this configurator. Values are validated against the firmware's accepted ranges on load and by `npm test` - see FIRMWARE_LIMITS in public/js/profile.js. After editing, run `npm run docs` to refresh the table in README.md.
$regionsComment: Optional repeater region scope, applied only when the operator ticks the box on the configure step. Order matters: a parent must appear before any child that names it, which is the order `region put` needs. Regions scope what a repeater re-transmits; they are not radio settings and not channels. Omit this key entirely to hide the feature.
